test_name: Mark-list key signatures of two, three and four columns, and the space around them (session 30)
description: One measure per system: m1/m4 C major, two columns of 1.0-wide noteheads (end 2.0); m2/m5 D major, three columns of sharps 1.1 wide (end 3.3); m3/m6 B flat major, four columns of flats 0.92 wide (end 3.68). Systems 1-3 show the engine's default clef, systems 4-6 hide it. The signature's start is its stencil's x = 0, the left edge of its first column; its end is columns x width. The harvest measures each path by its control-point hull: the sharps' hull starts at the start, the flats' 0.048 before it, the heads' at it. Measured on 2.24 and 2.26: the signature starts 0.75 after the staff's start with no clef, and 2.5 (2.24) or 3.025 (2.26) after the clef's left edge; the first note's centre is 2.5 after the signature's end, for two, three and four columns, on both versions.

assertions.description: Each of the six systems opens with its signature
System 4 hides its clef
System 5 hides its clef
System 6 hides its clef

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE WIDTH GROWS WITH THE COLUMNS ===

assertions.description: Two columns of heads: 2.0 wide
Three columns of sharps (with two bars): wider than two
Four columns of flats (with three bars): wider than three
Without a clef the signature is drawn the same
Without a clef the signature is drawn the same
Without a clef the signature is drawn the same

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: THE SPACE BEFORE THE SIGNATURE ===

assertions.description: No clef, two columns: the signature starts 0.75 after the staff's start
No clef, three columns: the signature starts 0.75 after the staff's start
No clef, four columns: the signature starts 0.75 after the staff's start (the flats' hull 0.048 before it)
With the clef, two columns: the signature starts 2.5 (2.24) or 3.025 (2.26) after the clef's left edge
With the clef, three columns: the same space as two
With the clef, four columns: the same space as two

assertions._comment: === SECTION 4: THE SPACE FROM THE LAST COLUMN TO THE FIRST NOTE ===

assertions.description: Two columns: the first note's centre is 2.5 after the signature's end (start + 2.0)
Three columns: the first note's centre is 2.5 after the signature's end (start + 3.3)
Four columns: the first note's centre is 2.5 after the signature's end (start + 3.68)
No clef, two columns: the same 2.5
No clef, three columns: the same 2.5
No clef, four columns: the same 2.5
